key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show device icon in the panel

key.name: show-bar
key.summary: Show vertical battery bar in the panel

key.name: colored-bar
key.summary: Color the bar and ring by charge level (off = like the other panel icons)

key.name: hover-card
key.summary: Show the info card on hover

key.name: placement
key.summary: 'separate' (own button next to quick settings) or 'quick-settings' (inside the quick settings icons)

key.name: color-high
key.summary: Color for a high charge level (Adwaita success, green 4)

key.name: color-medium
key.summary: Color for a medium charge level (Adwaita warning, yellow 5)

key.name: color-low
key.summary: Color for a low charge level (Adwaita error, red 3)

key.name: threshold-medium
key.summary: Up to this percentage the medium color is used

key.name: threshold-low
key.summary: Up to this percentage the low color is used

key.name: vendor-hid-enabled
key.summary: Show battery of devices provided by the optional vendor HID companion service (not available in UPower)
